# teams_targeting_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing TargetingPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `custom_tags_mode` (String) Maps to the -CustomTagsMode parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `manage_tags_permission_mode` (String) Maps to the -ManageTagsPermissionMode parameter.
- `shift_backed_tags_mode` (String) Maps to the -ShiftBackedTagsMode parameter.
- `suggested_preset_tags` (String) Maps to the -SuggestedPresetTags parameter.
- `team_owners_edit_who_can_manage_tags_mode` (String) Maps to the -TeamOwnersEditWhoCanManageTagsMode parameter.
